traceInterpretation: Event totals can overlap across categories and threads and are not unique wall time. Traced runs are excluded from comparative summaries.

appearance.note: Active-gesture and restored snapshots, not evidence of physical frame presentation.

limits: Actual Electron shell and preload with isolated userData; native NetSuite IPC is mocked.
App counts below 50 are single screening pairs, not repeated timing evidence.
Overview uses the actual UI minimum zoom of 0.2; large fixtures may not all fit on screen.
Focused/visible document checks; screenshots support visual review but do not establish presented frame rate.
Only App.vue and style.css differ from the pre-pan-change baseline; Notes loading fix and child index are common.
Mock external reads; real isolated SQLite workspace and Notes storage.
Pan samples use the restored initial workload; the separate first-use phase adds a retained query result, expanded deployments and controlled terminal output. Large Git diffs are not included.
Frame intervals cover selection and scripted pan together; first/warm readiness ends after two animation callbacks, not a measured physical display presentation.
No heap snapshots, 30-minute soak or 50-app capacity guarantee.
Cold means an uninitialized pane or terminal in an already populated renderer; shared modules may be warm. No live account/network startup latency is measured.
First-use readiness starts at click capture and ends after target content plus two animation callbacks. Dock/fit time is recorded separately.
An earlier preliminary batch and smoke runs are excluded from the accepted matrix.
Every matrix trial uses a new isolated profile and database; these runs are not a continuous soak or heap-stability test.
The active-pan snapshot is a separate visual probe, not comparative timing or proof of physical presentation.
